own_solution.law: Tf = (m1 T1 + m2 T2)/(m1 + m2); Sg = c[m1 ln(Tf/T1) + m2 ln(Tf/T2)]

defect_reasons.other: T8625 does not say when the further metal is added; the natural reading (before contact, at the hotter block's initial temperature) gives the certified answer, but adding it after contact had begun would change the entropy generated.
